reason: The text is the Genesis 4 narrative of Cain and Abel, the earliest period of human history in the biblical account. There are no Hebrew leaders present in this passage. While Cain does complain to God ("גָּדוֹל עֲוֺנִי מִנְּשֹׂא" - 'My punishment is greater than I can bear' in verses 13-14), this is an individual's personal lament about his own punishment, not leaders expressing grievance about the people. The statement describes a social or political complaint by leadership, which is entirely absent from this domestic narrative.
